description: This is a Java interface for the MerchantConfigurationService, defining methods related to merchant configurations, including retrieval, saving, and listing configurations by store and type.

classes.name: MerchantConfigurationService
classes.description: A Java interface that extends a generic service and declares methods for managing merchant configurations, including retrieval and updates based on store and configuration type.

methods.name: getMerchantConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves a specific merchant configuration by key for a given store.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates a merchant configuration entity.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all merchant configurations associated with a specific store.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Lists merchant configurations filtered by configuration type for a specific store.

methods.name: getMerchantConfig
methods.description: Retrieves merchant configuration details for a store, returning a MerchantConfig object.

methods.name: saveMerchantConfig
methods.description: Saves or updates merchant configuration details for a specific store.
